# Gouda Studios Agent Tools

> Agent-payable data tools for SAM.gov contract opportunities, SEC EDGAR filings, USAspending federal awards and GLEIF company LEI lookup. Pay per event, with no platform usage fee added. AI agents can pay per run through Apify agentic payments (x402, Skyfire) with no Apify account, or call the tools with an Apify API token, or through the Apify MCP server at https://mcp.apify.com.

Contact: m0f@mail.grokbot.com

## Tools

- [SAM.gov Contract Opportunities](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sam-gov-opportunities-feed/): Federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov with NAICS, PSC, set-aside, place of performance, response deadline and days left, contracting contacts, and a new-only monitoring mode. No API key needed. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per opportunity. Apify actor: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sam-gov-opportunities-feed.json
- [SEC EDGAR Filings](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sec-edgar-filings-feed/): New SEC EDGAR filings by ticker, CIK or form type from the official SEC APIs: form, filing date, 8-K items, company, SIC and direct document links. Change-only monitoring mode. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per filing. Apify actor: gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sec-edgar-filings-feed.json
- [USAspending Federal Awards](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/usaspending-awards-search/): Search U.S. federal contract and grant awards from the official USAspending.gov API by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Award amount, recipient UEI, agency and links. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.0015 per award. Apify actor: gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/usaspending-awards-search.json
- [GLEIF Company LEI Lookup](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/gleif-company-lei-lookup/): Verify companies worldwide from the official GLEIF LEI API: legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, direct and ultimate parent. KYB and enrichment for 2.9M+ entities. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.003 per company. Apify actor: gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/gleif-company-lei-lookup.json
